doctrine: One unbroken forward move through space, plant to mind. Camera is the electron, always travelling forward into the frame. The 30 cuts are waypoints on a single trajectory. Speed of forward travel is modulated by the cut sheet, never reversed.
global_constraints: Silent (no generated audio). Motion vector always forward, into the frame, never sideways, never pulling back. Deliberate, controlled energy. No camera shake, no whip, no fast snap zooms, no morphing. No new objects, no extra people appearing, no text, no logos. Hold the dark near-black teal palette and the cyan point-cloud look. Keep the first frame intact, animate from it.
input: Letterbox each 4608x1536 still into the model's 16:9 frame, animate, crop the center 3:1 band back. Generate ~5s, trim to duration.

frames.motion: Very slow forward push toward the plant across the black water. Faint vapor drifts from the stacks, the core glow flickers once. Locked horizon.
Continue pushing in toward the generator core; the single bright electron point detaches and drifts toward camera as it snaps free.
Forward glide down the conductor following the current; the chaotic particles resolve into one directed cyan line streaming toward camera.
Slow forward rise toward the transformer; a pulse of cyan light climbs the windings. Heroic, controlled, almost still.
Forward advance out along the first conductor into the switchyard; the cyan thread races ahead of camera into the distance.
Slow forward push toward the operator and the wall of screens; the load curve climbs a notch. Calm, the only human breath in the film.
Forward glide along the insulated cable; the cyan current pulses just beneath the surface, travelling with camera.
Forward and rising as the line lifts off the pylon into open sky; the cyan thread climbs the conductor. The moment the journey leaves the ground.
Forward aerial down the line of towers striding across dark country; faint cyan current runs the wires. Vast, relentless.
Forward aerial accelerating along the tower corridor; particle trails streak past, momentum building.
Forward drift across the river span on the giant towers; faint reflection shifts on the black water far below.
Forward glide down the highway corridor toward the distant city glow; the current flows ahead with the road.
Forward push toward the Atlanta skyline rising from the dark; the city resolves out of particles as we approach.
Forward and descending into the city streets down the distribution poles; the current threads down with us.
Push into the substation insulators; a crisp blue-cyan arc cracks across the gap ahead. Tension entering.
Forward dolly beneath the city distribution lines toward the venue; the cyan current pulses ahead, quickening.
Forward approach descending toward the glowing venue entrance; faint figures filter in. Arrival at the building.
Push into the breaker panel; the cyan feed presses down into the bus bars ahead. Final approach, intimate.
Forward glide along the row of breakers; indicators light in sequence as we pass, one point brighter than the rest.
Quick push into the breaker contact as it snaps closed; a small controlled cyan spark flashes at the gap. Percussive.
Forward plunge into the cable; camera becomes the electron entering the glowing tunnel, acceleration beginning.
Fast forward through the tunnel of streaking cyan particles toward the bright point growing ahead; vignette tightening.
Forward travel slows almost to a hover, settling on the lone speaker before the dark stage. Near frozen. The held breath.
Barely-moving push toward the hand reaching for the clicker; a soft edge glow on the fingers. Silence before release.
THE DROP. Fast push into the diode as a cyan bloom bursts from a single point. The forward rush punches through.
Forward burst out through the lens into the dark hall; a white-cyan flare blows out the frame. Liberation.
Full forward streak down the single beam over the rows of silhouetted heads toward one figure. Fast glide.
Forward push onto the young face as the beam catches the upturned eyes. Arrival at the target. Decelerate.
Hold tight on the face as cyan-white light blooms forward across the skin. The idea lands.
Forward flash to white as the stage ignites and the hall fills with light. The arrival.
